PM Modi to inaugurate Chennai Metro's Phase II first operational corridor

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the first operational section of Chennai Metro's Phase II project on October 11. This initial segment covers 14 kilometers of the new metro line.
